## Material startup optimization
Tested source commit 0648ac02213465ac1ff01593551118ab40deeae8. This updates previously accepted consumers; unchanged earlier claims are not being repeated.
## Files and verification
src/App.tsx, src/bootstrap-seed.ts, tests/bootstrap-seed.test.mjs, bilingual src/foundation-help.ts and src/help.ts; scripts/reception-startup-check.mjs. Exact HTTP/DOM evidence: docs/workspace-critical-path-evidence-2026-10-24.json.
npm run build passed help coverage (30 screens/556 controls), TypeScript and Vite; npm test 74 passed. Real DEV Electron: normal Reception publishes all 12 permitted cards together; zero global handbook, one initial auth/me + auth/workspaces + meta/settings snapshot; reference reads begin after scoped handbook. Normal samples 5378/5811ms versus prior 8701ms; samples are not an SLO.
## Recovery and regression
Persistent loss of actual reference response leaves home available, exposes separate Retry; restoring transport and retry hides error, same login. Final background-verified signed out. Required scoped-handbook failure keeps home gated until valid retry. Owner picker -> Doctor -> same-workspace reopen and separate Owner window passed; preferences restored. No patient/payment/clinical/config business writes.
## Limits
Named human fresh-data/Urdu/journey review remains pending; no q:tested or whole-screen/Phase2 completion claimed. Original background-recovery logout failed Server unreachable; isolated app closed and its session revocation is unconfirmed. Later full recovery rerun signed out successfully.
## Updated consumers
Moved the four real catalogue reads off workspace readiness into a guarded per-session background batch; successful catalogues are not reloaded on each workspace refresh. Independent visible bilingual reference failure/retry preserves usable authorized workspace. Lost-response retry observed on real DEV reads. Upgrade scenarios were not exercised and upgrade rule is omitted.
